verdict.rationale: Canny's integrations directory lists many native integrations with common tools. These include Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana with status sync, Discord notifications, and Fathom and Fireflies feedback capture, plus Gong, Intercom and Slack among 'dozens of other sources'. The MCP connector is described as a secure sign-in with 'no API keys, no engineering'. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the native integrations set up in a few clicks (only the MCP sign-in is described as no-code), independent or hands-on corroboration of setup ease, and per-integration setup docs.
